request.subject: TERRAIN:GRASS

layers.text: Style: hand-painted pixel art terrain texture for the adventure map of a classic 1990s fantasy strategy game: rich and soft, many close tones of the same few hues, gentle shading, no outlines.
layers.negative: photorealism, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, black outlines, thick outlines, cartoon outlines, neon, oversaturated

layers.text: Camera: straight top-down view of flat ground filling the whole canvas edge to edge, no perspective, no horizon, no lighting gradient.

Class: one dense ground texture that covers the whole image from edge to edge with the same material everywhere, evenly lit, with no focal object, nothing tall and no large empty flat area. The texture continues past all four edges of the image.
layers.negative: border, frame, vignette, dark corners, light spot, lighting gradient, perspective, horizon, tile edge, square island, scene, landscape, clearing, single big object, flat empty background

layers.text: Subject: the surface of the planet Mars seen from directly above, filling the whole image: fine rust-red dust with soft uneven darker and lighter patches and many separate rocks of very different sizes and shapes strewn over it: pebbles, angular stones, a few flat slabs, some half buried in the dust; every rock stands apart from the others, with a lit side and a soft shadow.
